title: Orkas-AI/Orkas: a local desktop where several agents share one job
friendlyTitle: Orkas: a desktop app where several agents share one job
summary: Orkas gained 1,118 stars on GitHub Trending on 1 November, and has about 6,000 in total. It is a free MIT-licensed desktop app for Mac and Windows. A commander turns a goal into tasks and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents, plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Hermes. You can use its built-in models or your own keys. Linux can run from source. There is no Linux installer yet.
friendlySummary: Orkas gained 1,118 stars on GitHub Trending on 1 November, and has about 6,000 in total. It is a free desktop app for Mac and Windows, under the MIT license. A lead agent turns a goal into tasks and coordinates 16 built-in specialists, plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Hermes. You can use its built-in models or your own keys. Linux can run from source. There is no Linux installer yet.
whyItMatters: Use it if you already pay for Claude or Codex and want those tools on one desk, with the data and keys staying local. The packaged app includes 500 credits for Orkas's own model. Paid plans add credits and sync. With your own keys, the model provider bills you, and Orkas says it does not add a markup. It does not replace the judgment of which agent is allowed to send mail or touch a file.
